facts.fact: Chathu taught Neela her letters at the Resin House long table when she was ten (sits beside F360, where Kirri taught the younger girls).

Neela concedes in the hall that the forty are free of paper but not of Chathu, who as first witness at all forty turnings remains a living witness; she says his mouth is now the high court's, not the queen's.
Neela states the Thurai on the beach as fourteen hundred, matching F795.
The widow's coin was paid out by the crown treasury, via Rema (F520).
